message: 命より重い豚でもただの豚

name: Synn
message: 「Differentiation, integration, what a great sensation~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, yes~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for calling, this is Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President!? Is it okay for you to be on the phone right now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte? W-Well, it's fine, I guess... What's wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, you see... I just don't understand.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Was there something difficult in the material?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. What I don't understand is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How to study without falling asleep!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am trying my best, however, the very instant I grip my pencil--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa! Wake up, wake up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!! Once again, I have wandered off into Portopia.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Utopia. Hmm~~ You weren't like that at our study session earlier, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once I get home, I end up relaxing too much, so it's no good~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You need a certain level of tension. Like having Riesling keep watch over you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grandpa is so gentle, I don't think he is very suited for that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Then, what about asking Amyrina?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She is already fast asleep right next to me~~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then, um... well, you know...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's it! I simply need to study together with you again, Mr. President.」
She effortlessly blurts out the very thing I was hesitating to say.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, is that really okay this late at night?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tomorrow is a day off, after all. If it's for studying, I'll be fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Riesling-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He says that if it's the President, there's nothing to worry about.」
I see. Being trusted like that actually puts more pressure on me.
Like if I do anything, it'll be a huge deal--wait, what am I even planning to do!?
No, no. I'm the Student Council President, so I have to properly guide my underclassman down the right path.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Got it. Then I'll wait at home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y♪」
Now then, maybe I should get some tea ready.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good evening!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That was fast!」

name: Riesling
message: 「As this is an emergency, please forgive the intrusion.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, butler. I dunno about spoiling the angel this much.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I believe the wretched culture of torture should be eradicated immediately.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Torture...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, Jiiya. I'll do my best.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Have a safe time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, have some tea.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hii~~ It's so bitter~~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「It's perfect for waking you up, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~. I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, shall we get started?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes ♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Spring is so warm and mild... dozing... dozing... so warm and mild...」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh! Lolo-chi spotted. And wide open too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Poison Sting, poooke!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaoo!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hiding your head while your butt's sticking right out!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you doing all of a sudden!」

name: Sally
message: 「You were sleeping so I woke you up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gulp.\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey. Whatcha doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm studying. I don't have time to play along with Omake-san's games today.」

name: Sally
message: 「Aw, boring.」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to join in too, Sally-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, pffft.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sigh... Omake-san really is a free spirit, isn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「Jealous?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Certainly... it might be best if I didn't have to study at all. But...」

name: Synn
message: 「But?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fun things, painful things. Happy things, sad things. Taking them all together is what makes every day wonderful, I think.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If there were only fun things, you wouldn't even realize they were fun, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why tough things, painful things, and sad things--every single one of them must lead to having fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. Wouldn't it be nice if you could have fun studying too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truly~~」
For a while, only the sound of pencils scratching across paper echoed through the room.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. How should I go about doing this part?」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, make the subject and object clear... If it's hard to tell, draw a line like this--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm... hmm...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nod... nod...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she's nodding off again...\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Shake, shake!* Ah, this won't do at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Want something to drink?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a brilliant idea! I'll go brew some tea to wake myself up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know how to make it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have a rough idea, so I'll borrow your kitchen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, go ahead.」
I wonder if she'll be okay...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thanks.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oho~~. I see, you really take thorough notes, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Without these, prepping and reviewing would be tough. *Sip...*」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's good!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Failure is the mother of success, after all.」
Huh? She didn't get the idiom wrong--wait, that's not what I should be pointing out.
Until just a moment ago, Lolotte was definitely sitting across from me.
She's kind of close. Actually, she's right next to me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let us continue from earlier...」
It doesn't feel like she's doing it on purpose; she just naturally ended up here.
Plus, I'd just turned my writing supplies and notebook toward her a moment ago.
Even so, I'm the only one whose heart is pounding, and it's kind of embarrassing.
I'm the upperclassman here, so I've got to pull myself together.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do second-years really do stuff this hard~~?」
Ugh. Her soft upper arm is pressing against me......

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haaah...... I really need to try harder at studying too, don't I.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you put in the effort now, I think it'll be easier later. You won't have to cram like this either.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so!?」

name: Synn
message: 「This happens because you're always slacking off. You've got to prep and review properly every day.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though, you're panicking quite a bit yourself this time, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's because...... the Student Council was so much fun that I just couldn't help it......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right~~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~~. There's no way I could do something that's difficult even for you, President~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's it! Why don't we work hard together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As long as you're by my side, President, I'm sure I...... can do my best at anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I just feel like I can, though I don't think the results will follow.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, that kind of positive attitude is what matters most. So it's all good.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, true. First, we have to beat the sleepiness.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~~. I won't fall asleep anymore~~!\s01」
And so, while chatting together, the two of us fill our notebooks with writing.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. Today is, well, your birthday, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Even I completely forgot, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the wonderful and precious anniversary of the day you were born into this world, you know? You mustn't forget it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha......\s02 Say, Lolotte. When's your birthday?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mine...... you ask?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmmmm... Well, since it's the day I was born in this world... that would make it December 25th.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the wonderful present today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't be satisfied with just that, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I secretly prepared a present from myself as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?!」
A present straight from the young lady of the Rosenkreuz family!!
What kind of present could the wealthiest family in all of Ryuusei Town possibly prepare!?
Wait, no, stop that!
What matters with a present is the thought behind it, not its monetary value!

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here is your present.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Isn't this... your piggy bank, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. This is Tontoro's little brother, Peetoro.」

name: Synn
message: 「So it's a matching figurine with yours, Lolotte~~」
Just having something matching with Lolotte makes me happy.
Though, the fact that I don't have any money to put inside it is just part of my charm.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Here you go. Please be careful not to drop it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Thank--whoa!」
The instant I held it, I felt a heavy, solid thud of weight.
Could it be that this thing is packed to the brim with something inside?
Gahhh. Compared to this weight... a human life is... light... far too light!
And what's more, I don't see any lid to take things out!
To get whatever's inside, the only way would be to smash its cute little form.
However...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please take good care of it\s04 If you break it or anything, I'll cry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You bet I will!」
Just like that, the secret treasure inevitably became my own prized possession.
